desc:
One Piece inspired battlegrounds game

Character(s):
Luffy (pre-timeskip), Zoro (pre-timeskip), Rob Lucci, Sanji (pre-timeskip), and Law.

Early Access Character(s):
Luffy (TS) and Red Haired Shanks

PC Controls:
C = Burst (Evasive)
Q = Dash
Click (Hold) = Punch
F (Hold) = Block
G = Awaken
1, 2, 3, 4 = Moves/Skills

Mobile support is also provided for this game.

Please consider leaving a like and adding this game to your favorites.
